newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares extend losses, eyes on Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares extend losses, eyes on Wall St.

text.p: Portuguese shares closed under pressure in light turnover of just 4.5 billion escudos after Wall Street opened lower amid fears of a further U.S. rate hike, dealers said. After today's U.S. jobless claims data came out in line with expectations, the market's attention turned to tomorrow's U.S. unemployment data. The trend tomorrow will depend heavily on other markets, dealers said. "Tomorrow we'll see whether U.S. unemployment data point to another U.S. rate hike," said one operator. The most active stocks on Lisbon bourse included Lisnave, Cimpor, Banco Totta e Acores and Portugal Telecom.
